**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

The Agreement imposes no non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-poaching covenant on us. I checked the planner's candidate sections (§ 12 Customer Responsibilities, § 16 Confidentiality, § 30 General) plus §§ 11 and 13, and ran targeted searches on "solicit", "employ or engage", "induce", "hire", "recruit", "personnel", "employment", and "non-compete" — the only responsive language is § 12.3, which runs in our favour:

> "Nothing restricts Customer from ... hiring any person who responds to general recruitment ... Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment."

Because we carry no restriction at all, the rule sits at the **preferred** level, and the fallback narrowing mechanics (mutuality, limitation to personnel engaged on the Services, 12-month tail, general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs) are not engaged. No redline proposed. Separately noted, not flagged: § 12.4 restricts Vendor from marketing a competing service, which benefits us.
